🦖🐾 Parents, the PAW Patrol Dino World adventure is getting bigger! 
Jump into Dino Plains 🌿 a vast open-world environment filled with dinosaurs, missions, and exploration, inspired by the upcoming PAW Patrol Dino Movie 🌋 
Play as Rubble, Zuma, and Rocky alongside Chase, Marshall, and Skye, each using their unique abilities to solve challenges, rescue dinosaurs, and uncover secrets across Dino Island. Meet Ryder, Eugenia, and Heidi as the story unfolds through gameplay-driven missions. 
From exploration and teamwork to dinosaur rescues, this video game experience is designed for family fun! 

Coming soon to PlayStation!
